name: raisedadead-plugins
description: Two Claude Code plugins that make "done" a checkable fact: dossier runs a piece of work from one plan file, whetstone applies the craft at each gate.

plugins.name: dossier
plugins.description: One plan file per piece of work and a ds command for every repeatable step: plan, plan check, build in scoped rows, one review, shaped commits, close. Built for one operator rig.

plugins.name: whetstone
plugins.description: Engineering-craft skills: red-green TDD, a flaky-test rate, diagnosis, doubt review, grilling, a merge check, grounded research reports, HTML reports, skill linting and a staged-diff column budget. TDD, the merge check, skill lint, column budget and HTML report end in a script's exit code; the flaky-test rate is computed and printed, and sets no exit code; doubt review, grilling, diagnosis and the research verdicts are model-judgment.
